game.title: Bear Rush
game.tagline: Run the ridge. Hunt the herd. Fear the crevasse.
game.footer: High country keeps its own rules.
menu.title: Main menu
controls.title: How to hunt
controls.desktop: W A S D / arrows run in every direction · Shift sprints · Space / E pounces · drag mouse to look
controls.touch: Touch: left stick runs · Sprint and Pounce buttons · drag to look
controls.goal: Chase salmon, honey, fawns, deer, elk and moose. Every catch scores; combos pay more.
controls.hazards: Only three dangers: poisonous forage, steel traps and the mountainside crevasse. Each costs one life — you have three.
hint.move: W A S D or the left stick moves the bear in any direction. Turn with the mouse or your drag.
hint.sprint: Hold Shift (or SPRINT) to gather speed — but you lose footing faster on steep ground.
hint.hunt: Close in on wildlife and catch them. Fleeing deer, elk and moose need a pounce or a sprint.
hint.hazards: Three dangers only: poisonous mushrooms, bear traps, and the deep crevasse. Each takes one life.
pause.title: Rest on the ridge
pause.message: The mountain will wait. Your hunt is paused.
settings.title: Mountain settings
settings.privacy: Your settings and best hunt stay in this browser. No account needed.
results.title: The hunt is over
results.message: The herd scatters into the trees. Ready to run the ridge again?
